verdict.rationale: Email forwarding is clearly documented as a first-class API feature (create-email-forwarding), supporting the 'email forwarding on my domain' part of the story, but there is no mention anywhere in the evidence pack of free SSL/HTTPS certificate provisioning bundled with domains, so the 'costs nothing extra' SSL claim is unsupported. Missing for 10: any documentation of free SSL/TLS certificate issuance or automatic HTTPS setup bundled with domain registration.
